result.description: LinkedIn Marketing/Advertising API: manage ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, targeting and analytics programmatically (Campaign Manager features).
result.auth_detail: 3-legged OAuth2 authorization code only; 2-legged client credentials not available for marketing use cases. Requires app approved for Advertising API product.
result.access_detail: Must apply for Advertising API product on app's Product tab; LinkedIn reviews and approves (can reject). Development tier: reads unlimited, edits up to 5 ad accounts. Standard tier (multi-account campaign mgmt) needs further discretionary approval. Free to use once approved.
result.api_notes: Versioned REST APIs (Marketing versions, e.g. 202601 sunsetting 2027-01-15). Covers ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, targeting, reporting/analytics, plus conversions/lead gen in other docs.
result.blocker: Advertising API product requires LinkedIn app review/approval; Standard tier upgrade discretionary; data-only upgrade requests rejected. Per-user OAuth only.

evidence.quote: The 2-legged client credentials flow is not available for any marketing use cases.
All these permission scopes are 3-legged permissions requiring explicit consent from a LinkedIn member.
LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion and a partner might not be upgraded even if they meet these minimum requirements.
LinkedIn has two tiers of access to our Advertising API: Development and Standard.
These APIs provide all features available in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including creation and management of ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.
The Advertising API enables developers to manage LinkedIn's campaign management platform on behalf of clients through APIs.
MCP server for the LinkedIn Marketing API that can read and write campaigns, analytics, and creatives from any MCP client.
